format: JavaScript (Next.js configuration file, ES module format)
description: This is a Next.js configuration file (next.config.mjs) that sets up development parameters, rewrites for proxying backend API calls, and HTTP headers for security. It defines custom rewrite rules for API endpoints, manages environment variables for backend URLs, and specifies headers for security hardening.

methods.name: rewrites
methods.description: Defines URL rewrite rules to proxy API calls to a backend server based on environment variables, with fallbacks.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Sets security headers for all routes, including content type options and referrer policy.
